official.citizenship_residency: Reserved for applicants from institutions in the 21 listed Latin American and Caribbean countries.
official.international_eligibility: Open to international applicants from the listed Latin American and Caribbean countries; Mexican nationals apply under the domestic Beca al Talento Académico instead.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applies to professional programmes (carreras profesionales) at the Tecnológico de Monterrey; the award is tied to the admitted campus. Programmes Medico Cirujano, B.A. in Finance and B.A. in Strategy and Business Transformation have a specific scholarship quota. High-selectivity programmes require admission by 10 December 2026 to participate.
official.duration: Entrance scholarship for a professional degree beginning in August 2027, subject to annual conservation requirements
official.description: The Beca al Talento Académico Internacional is the Tecnológico de Monterrey scholarship that recognises young people with an extraordinary academic record, aimed at candidates from institutions in a named group of Latin American and Caribbean countries, granting support of between 40% and 60% of tuition cost - valid for the admitted campus - to admitted professional-programme students with an average of at least 90/100 who are under 21 years of age at application.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a partial tuition award of 40%-60% of your colegiatura at the campus that admitted you - not a full scholarship - so the real financial planning starts after the award: you still fund the remaining tuition percentage, plus living costs in Mexico, yourself. Two gates decide everything: an average of at least 90/100 in your bachillerato and a PAA score of at least 1,360 points (SAT/ACT converted to the PAA scale count, and you get up to two attempts with the second sitting closing 16 January 2027). The administrative traps are unusually harsh: you must be admitted first, apply on a single date through solicitud.tec.mx, and pay the place reservation by 25 February 2027 or the award is cancelled outright - missing that payment after winning is the most common way to lose this scholarship.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Students from the 21 listed Latin American and Caribbean countries with a 90/100+ bachillerato average, under 21, admitted to a Tec professional programme for August 2027, who can sit the PAA and reach 1,360 points.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your country appears on the official list before anything else - it is the first eligibility screen
Book your PAA sitting early; if you need a second attempt, remember the final date is 16 January 2027
Secure admission for August 2027, and by 10 December 2026 if your programme is high-selectivity
Have the official (SEP-issued) copy of your bachillerato transcript ready to upload
From 24 August 2026, complete the profile evaluation in Becas y Apoyos Educativos on solicitud.tec.mx and submit on the single active date
Calendar the post-result dates the moment you win: reservation payment by 25 February 2027 and acceptance by 4 March 2027
common_rejection_risks: Missing the place-reservation payment by 25 February 2027 after winning, which cancels the award
A PAA score below 1,360 points, including a converted SAT/ACT below that threshold
An average below 90/100 over the required two-year accumulated grades
Being 21 or older at the time of application
Coming from a country not on the official list, or already studying elsewhere at university level
Expecting an appeal: the decision is final and non-appealable with no feedback process
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: With support capped at 40%-60% (up to 80% only if the Scholarships Committee approves the socioeconomic complement by 30 March 2027), you must still fund the remaining tuition share plus flights, housing, insurance and living expenses in Mexico; the award includes no travel or living-cost support.
document_audit: Transcripts must be official copies issued by the relevant authority - school-issued printouts are not accepted
SAT or ACT takers must convert their score to the PAA scale and document the conversion
The application is submitted inside the admission application on solicitud.tec.mx, on one date only and only for the admitted campus
alerts: Admission deadlines bite before the call closes: 20 January 2027 generally, 10 December 2026 or 13 January 2027 for several competitive programmes
Keeping the award requires passing every subject and intensive course, carrying the full academic load, participating in the Programa de Becarios and maintaining a final average of at least 85/100
The socioeconomic complement is exclusive to this award and cannot be combined with other talent supports
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the admission application at solicitud.tec.mx, gain admission for August 2027, sit the PAA (minimum 1,360), apply through the Becas y Apoyos Educativos section on the single active date before 22 January 2027, then await results on 18 February 2027, pay the reservation by 25 February 2027 and accept by 4 March 2027.
